text.en: This weapon's grenades are insectoid robots that chase targets and explode close to them.

Fires seeking robotic droids that can crawl over surfaces and detonate near enemies or after 2.5 seconds.

Kills spawn more droids based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 2 
• Elites: 3
• Minibosses and Bosses: 6
• Players: 1
